build.validation: source contract only; no image build or runtime test performed

telegram.provisioning: separate private configuration and distinct bot credential; not initialized by this source contract
telegram.mode: upstream polling default; no public ingress required

activation_caveats: Preserve dispatcher/s6 bootstrap and UID drop. Do not override image entrypoint.
Bootstrap seeds and may modify state, permissions and API credentials; separately approved first-start validation is required.
Use default state path: wrapper fixes HOME=/opt/data even when HERMES_HOME is overridden.
Explicit gateway command follows upstream compose; simultaneous supervised gateway slots must be checked during future startup test.

provenance.revision_rule: BUILD_SOURCE_COMMIT is the exact custom integration commit being built, not the upstream baseline. No floating tag is a deployment pin.
provenance.build_inputs_note: Upstream Dockerfile is reused unchanged. Its package manager/network build steps are not claimed byte-reproducible; archive dependency/provenance evidence when a future approved build runs.

version_validation.warning: Upstream project metadata is a development placeholder; runtime release identity comes from install-stamp.json. Validate release tag-to-commit and built install stamp before publishing.

patches.policy: No old deployment settings, credentials, conversations, memory or custom feature patches are carried silently. Required future changes belong in reviewed integration PRs.
